The '''Imperial Hotel''' was a luxury hotel on '''[[Bonadan/Legends|Bonadan]]''', considered the best in the city. [[Hart-and-Parn Gorra-Fiolla|Fiolla]] and her assistant [[Magg]] stayed in this hotel during an audit for the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]].
